newsitem.title: UK: UK's C5 to show Aston Villa UEFA Cup ties.
newsitem.headline: UK's C5 to show Aston Villa UEFA Cup ties.

text.p: Britain's Channel 5 (C5) has bought the live television rights to Aston Villa's home matches in European soccer's UEFA Cup next season, the broadcaster said on Wednesday.
The deal adds to a growing portfolio of European soccer rights for C5, the fifth terrestrial channel launched four months ago.
It follows a similar arrangement between C5 and Chelsea Village Plc to show the London club's home matches in the European Cup Winners' Cup in the coming season.
UEFA Cup ties are played on Tuesdays and Cup Winners' Cup games on Thursday nights starting in September.
"This is a very exciting deal because Aston Villa have an excellent chance of going right through to the latter stages of the tournament," said Robert Charles, the channel's controller of sport.
C5 will also show Newcastle United Plc's European Cup preliminary round second leg tie on August 27.
Newcastle will play either Partizan Belgrade or Croatia Zagreb in a match which will determine whether the English club qualify for a place in the big money Champions' League.
C5, in which Pearson Plc and United News & Media Plc are key shareholders, has so far struggled to establish itself on a limited budget.
Its largest audience to date was for the Poland-England World Cup soccer match in May when five million people tuned in to the new channel.
But its audiences are generally much more modest and its average share of viewing is running at under three percent. The channel hopes to build this to around five percent by the end of the year.
